verdict.rationale: Raygun docs show error grouping, prioritization by occurrence/users affected, filtering, and a new error-frequency chart on search results (docs-3, docs-7, docs-19), which supports volume/trend visibility within a project, but there is no evidence of cross-project or cross-team rollup dashboards, per-release new-issue breakdowns, or explicit 'top regressions' reporting for engineering leadership. Missing for 10: multi-project/team aggregated dashboards, release-based new-issue tracking, regression ranking across releases, and any leadership-level rollup view.
